Fixed. There were two bugs in `rtl/regfile.v`:

1. `rdata1`/`rdata2` didn't force `0` when the read address was `0` (rule 1 priority), so writing to register 0 while reading address 0 would incorrectly bypass `wdata` instead of returning `8'h00`.
2. `rdata2`'s write-bypass didn't check `we`, so it would bypass to `wdata` even when `we == 0`.

Both are fixed, and `TEST PASSED` — all tests pass.
